intro.title: FUNDA — Breadcrumb Navigator
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Breadcrumb Navigator — an automatically generated trail that reflects the current route hierarchy (Home → Products → Electronics → Laptops) with each segment being a clickable link. The breadcrumbs update dynamically as the user navigates without manual configuration per page. You will listen to the Router's NavigationEnd events, walk the ActivatedRoute tree to collect route data.breadcrumb values, and render them as a reactive list.
intro.usecase: Breadcrumbs are a UX staple in e-commerce category pages, file managers, CMS admin panels, settings hierarchies, and multi-level data drill-downs. The automatic-generation approach demonstrates architectural thinking: data-driven, DRY, and maintainable as the route tree grows.
